scope: Batch 07F-2: Magneto House of X and Mangog source-linked tactical notes, original and untested.

decisions.title: Pick Guidance before the eligible team fight
decisions.text: Magneto (House of X) can provide Guidance utility to qualifying allies through his pre-fight, but it is not a universal effect for every team member. Verify the ally's tags and intended passive Parry Stun before using a slot.

decisions.title: Build Heavy Prowess only from stable openings
decisions.text: A Heavy can develop Prowess for an upcoming Special, but the defender must leave room to charge safely. Avoid treating every wall position or stun-immune matchup as an opportunity for the same setup.

decisions.title: Check Metal and Armor Break interactions separately
decisions.text: SP1 can prepare Armor Break for SP2, with a different damage effect against Metal opponents in the recorded kit. Confirm the opponent's Metal tag and effect protections rather than claiming one damage type works on all targets.

decisions.title: Build Hatred without assuming a fixed combo timer
decisions.text: Mangog can develop Hatred from eligible combo endings and SP1; track the actual meter instead of entering every Special at a predetermined combo count. The Enrage transition needs the right resource state.

decisions.title: Use SP2 control only while its conditions permit it
decisions.text: SP2 can provide Power Steal and a potential Stun opening that supports further pressure. A defender immune to Stun or protected from Power Steal can remove that opportunity, making a normal safe punish preferable.

decisions.title: Sustain Enrage from real Hatred triggers
decisions.text: Once Enrage is active, continued Hatred generation can help maintain the offensive window. Do not force unsafe hits merely to prolong the mode; watch the defender's power bar and the current remaining duration.
